<thought>The specific functional‑group criteria returned no templates, so we broaden the search to any templates that can be applied to the target molecule. By retrieving a list of candidate templates (up to 20), we can then test each one to see if it matches the molecule and, if so, apply it to obtain the possible precursors. This will let us collect all precursor sets required for the answer.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "limit": 20
}
</action_input>
